name: Gangsters in Love
source:
Falling in love with a gangster is a dangerous choice...
-Story-

"Welcome to our world."

You're leading an ordinary life in sunny California when suddenly you get kidnapped by LA's most wanted gang!

Thrown into the extravagant life of these stylish but dangerous gangsters, you must choose one of them to watch over you...but who can you trust?

Living in the gang's world isn’t easy, yet in the face of all the shootouts and explosions, an undeniable attraction begins to form...

Not only are you the key to important information the gang needs, but you are also in possession of something else they are missing in their lives: your heart!
translation:
爱上一个黑帮是一个危险的选择……
-故事-

“欢迎来到我们的世界。”

你在阳光明媚的加州过着平凡的生活，突然被洛杉矶的头号通缉犯绑架了！

被扔进这些时尚但危险的歹徒的奢侈生活中，你必须选择其中一个来监视你……但你能相信谁呢？

生活在帮派的世界里并不容易，但面对所有的枪战和爆炸，一种不可否认的吸引力开始形成……

你不仅是帮派所需的重要信息的关键，而且还拥有他们生活中缺少的其他东西：你的心！
